reviews.title: Account got banned, and please make a proper desktop or web app.
reviews.text:
Is the year 2026 and there is still no way to speak in a clubhouse room on my computer without using some 3rd party malware.  Please just make a proper web app.  It’s not that hard.  

Also my original account was banned, I emailed for an appeal.  And it’s been almost 2 months with no answer.   They didn’t tell me what I did to get banned, and have no course for correction.  I also got no warnings or anything.  As far as I know I wasn’t breaking their TOS, the only thing I can think of is that I was using a branch of clubdeck and they flagged it as unauthorized or bot movement or something?  I don’t troll or anything, so I don’t know what else it could have been.   

I like the platform and I think it could rival discord but the lack of a web app, or accepted desktop app, and that you can’t have your account signed into multiple devices all contribute to the fact that this app has real issues.  As well as the fact that your account can just suddenly be banned with no explanation or recourse.

reviews.title: Notification spam and No support
reviews.text:
If you hate being spammed with notifications, don’t even download it. There’s no way to turn off engagement spam notifications unless you turn all of them off, including ones from your friends. You can turn off notifications from your friends, but you can’t turn off notifications about random topics from outside your houses being pushed in your face all day?

I spent about ten minutes filling out a help request to see if this could be changed at all, and got an instant reply from a canned email response telling me how to access notifications from settings, and that my support ticket was now closed. Instantly deleted the app.

reviews.title: Clubhouse: 6 Years of Loyalty, Zero Respect for Users
reviews.text:
Very Disappointed

I’ve been on Clubhouse for about 6 years and was consistently among the platform’s top users, ranking around the top 0.5–1% based on activity and Karma.

Despite that history, Clubhouse suspended my account and refused to provide any meaningful explanation or evidence. Their customer service has been extremely disappointing.

From my experience, Clubhouse is also becoming a platform where freedom of speech feels increasingly restricted. Users can lose years-old accounts without being given a clear explanation or a meaningful opportunity to defend themselves. I understand that platforms have rules, but there should also be transparency, consistency, and a fair appeal process.

What is even more concerning is what happens to money left on suspended accounts. I had user tips on my account, and instead of clearly explaining how those funds will be returned to me, Clubhouse has provided no real answer. Users should not simply lose money they earned or received because their account was suspended.

I also reported an impersonation account that was using my name and my photo and had the extremely hateful name “I Hate Jews.” I reported this account repeatedly—around 100 times—and Clubhouse failed to take meaningful action.

So, to summarize my experience:

• 6+ years on the platform
• Top 0.5–1% of users
• Account suspended without a meaningful explanation
• Poor customer service
• Money/tips left on the account with no clear payout process
• An account impersonati

reviews.title: Stole my money
reviews.text:
I’ve been a loyal Clubhouse user for over 6 years, and my experience with the platform has ended in a way that has been incredibly disappointing and frustrating.

After the introduction of the Gold Rewards program, I found myself unable to access funds that I believe I had earned through my activity on the platform. My account was deactivated, and despite numerous attempts to contact customer service, I received little to no meaningful assistance. Emails went unanswered, and I was never given a clear explanation about what happened to my account or my funds.

What makes the situation even more concerning is that when I attempted to participate in a town hall discussion to seek answers, my account was allegedly restricted, and I was no longer able to access the platform. I was also unable to create a new account, which left me feeling completely shut out with no path to resolve the issue.

As a user who invested years into building a presence on Clubhouse, I expected transparency, communication, and fair treatment. Instead, I was left without answers and without access to approximately $3,600 that I believe is owed to me.

I hope Clubhouse will address these concerns, provide clear communication to affected users, and create a fair process for resolving disputes. Until then, I cannot recommend the platform based on my experience.
